facts.text: Every Babson student takes Foundations of Management and Entrepreneurship as a first-year student, launching an actual business with up to $3,000 in startup loan funding.

sources.title: How Undergraduate Experiential Learning Can Pave the Way for ...
sources.quote: Every Babson student participates in Foundations of Management and Entrepreneurship (FME). Students break into teams and come up with a business idea, determine whether that idea is feasible, create a launch plan, and qualify for a loan of up to $3,000 from the College as startup money.
